free_tier.stated: 5 GB of free storage for files in Microsoft Teams; images and videos are not saved on OneDrive and have no storage limit; attached files go to the Microsoft Teams Chat Files folder in the user's OneDrive

egress.terms: Unmetered; share links resolve to OneDrive direct URLs.

tooling: Graph API chatMessageHostedContent + driveItem; no rclone backend for Teams specifically (use the onedrive remote pointing at the Chat Files folder)
chaining: Effectively OneDrive consumer's 5 GB wearing a different hat - Teams free files ARE OneDrive files, so this is not a second quota. The one genuine loophole claim on the page is 'Images and videos are not saved on OneDrive and don't have a storage limit' - unverified whether that means arbitrary files can be smuggled as media.
limits_note: 5 GB total files; 250 GB max individual file upload/download; chat messages unlimited.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: no signup identity requirement is stated on the storage page read; it only describes where personal-use data is stored

reliability_note: Leaving a community does not revoke other members' access; deleting the 5 GB block blocks attaches but not history.

evidence.proved: 'The amount of free storage ... is 5 GB'; 'Images and videos are not saved on OneDrive and don't have a storage limit'
first-page statement of the 5 GB personal Teams allowance
the 250 GB individual-file limit named in limits_note is stated on the first-party page
evidence.quote: The upload and download sizes for individual files in OneDrive is 250 GB.

evidence.proved: the page describes file storage location only, not a signup identity requirement
evidence.quote: When you attach a file or other data to a message in a chat or community, the file is uploaded to the Microsoft Teams Chat Files folder in your OneDrive.

notes: 5 GB free per person for files in Teams; images/videos explicitly do not count and have no storage limit; files land in the 'Microsoft Teams Chat Files' folder in the user's OneDrive.

dead_end.why: 5 GB free per person for files in Teams; images/videos explicitly do not count and have no storage limit; files land in the 'Microsoft Teams Chat Files' folder in the user's OneDrive.
